title: Hold a builder's licence
what: Hold the state's builder (or building contractor) licence or registration before contracting for or carrying out building work.

sources.title: Home Building Act 1989 (NSW)
sources.publisher: Official register text via the Open Australian Legal Corpus
sources.quote: A person must not contract to do— (a) any residential building work, or (b) any specialist work, except as or on behalf of an individual, partnership or corporation that is the holder of a contractor licence authorising its holder to contract to do that work.

marks.reason: A licence with qualification or experience tests is needed before contracting.
